topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon her notebook, tucked away under a stack of old magazines. The cover was worn, the edges frayed, almost as if it was deliberately hidden. Curiosity got the better of me. I opened it and there it was, her bucket list. Each item meticulously handwritten, a testament to dreams and aspirations I had no idea existed. Travel to Japan, learn calligraphy, adopt a rescue dog. The list went on, a stark reminder of the parts of her I hadn’t known. I felt an urge to close it, to respect the privacy it seemed to demand, but I couldn't. Each line was a window, and I was peeking in, uninvited.
